meta.name: analogy-extraction
meta.description: Extract transferable structural principles from source domains. Orchestrates source identification → abstraction → structural mapping → transfer validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从已知领域提取可迁移的结构原理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要从其他领域借鉴模式来解决新问题
copy.tagline_en: Extract transferable structural principles from known domains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often borrow patterns from other fields to solve new problems

howto.what: 执行四个阶段的流程：识别候选源领域、提取抽象原理、进行结构映射、验证转换深度，最终输出经过验证的深层类比。
howto.when: 当用户需要从特定源领域提取可迁移的结构原则，或要求进行类比分析时触发。

say.text: 请从生物学中提取可迁移的结构原则。
say.note: Claude会启动源识别和抽象提取。

say.text: 比较足球战术和商业策略的深层结构。
say.note: 触发结构映射和验证阶段。

say.text: 验证这个类比是表面还是深层。

howto.what_en: Executes a four-stage process: identify candidate source domains, extract abstract principles, perform structural mapping, and validate transfer depth, yielding validated deep analogies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to extract transferable structural principles from specific source domains, or requests analogy analysis.

say_en.text: Extract transferable structural principles from biology.
say_en.note: Claude starts source identification and abstraction.

say_en.text: Compare deep structure of soccer tactics and business strategy.
Validate if this analogy is surface or deep.
